OTECH 1D Laser USB 2.0 Cable OTE-BS1D900 Barcode Scanner

The OTECH OTE-BS1D900 is a robust 1D laser barcode scanner designed to efficiently capture 1D barcodes with high accuracy. It connects via USB 2.0 for a stable and fast data transfer, making it ideal for a wide range of business environments such as retail, inventory management, and logistics. With its user-friendly design and easy integration, the OTECH OTE-BS1D900 is the perfect solution for improving productivity and streamlining barcode scanning processes.

Features of OTECH 1D Laser USB 2.0 Cable Barcode Scanner

  • 1D Laser Scanning: Supports efficient scanning of 1D barcodes with precise accuracy.
  • USB 2.0 Connectivity: Provides reliable, fast data transmission and easy plug-and-play setup.
  • High-Speed Scanning: Scans barcodes quickly to enhance operational efficiency and reduce wait times.
  • Ergonomic Design: Lightweight and comfortable to use for extended periods, reducing hand strain.
  • Wide Compatibility: Compatible with various devices, operating systems, and barcode formats, making it versatile for different industries.
  • Durable Construction: Built to withstand everyday use in retail and warehouse environments, ensuring long-lasting reliability.
  • Plug-and-Play Functionality: Simple USB connection with no need for additional software installation.
  • Cost-Effective: An affordable solution without sacrificing quality or performance.
  • Versatile Applications: Suitable for retail, logistics, inventory management, and more.
